title: SNT workspace status report, schema_version 1
description: The report written by the snt_workspace_check pipeline to <workspace root>/snt_status/status_<UTC timestamp>.json and, byte-identical, to status_latest.json. FROZEN at phase 4 (PRODUCT_SPEC.md section 6, decision D18). Compatibility rules: adding a key, a status/position/resolved_from/source value, or a blind_spots line is NOT a breaking change and keeps schema_version 1; renaming or removing a key or value, changing a type, or changing what a value means is breaking and requires schema_version 2. This schema is deliberately strict (additionalProperties: false, closed enums) so the producer cannot drift silently; a CONSUMER must instead ignore unknown keys and tolerate unknown enum values. Every key is always present; a value that does not apply is null, never omitted. Strings marked x-display-only are text for a human and must never be parsed or compared.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to this schema.

generated_at.description: UTC, second precision, ending in Z (e.g. 2026-09-29T13-39-32Z in the filename, 2026-09-29T13:39:32Z here).

snt_workspace_check_version.description: The version of the snt_workspace_check pipeline that generated this report. A run cannot currently read the name of the pipeline version executing it, so this is null until a source for it is found; the key is frozen regardless.

workspace.description: Slug of the OpenHEXA workspace the check ran in.

repo.description: owner/repo whose releases the workspace was checked against.

mode.description: verification: a target release was resolved and every file has a verdict relative to it. attribution: no target; files are attributed to the releases whose bytes they hold.

target_release.description: Always an object, in both modes. In attribution mode tag and published_at are null and resolved_from says why.

resolved_from.description: parameter: the release_tag parameter (in attribution mode: the reserved value 'none'). marker: the tag in .snt_release. nothing_given: no parameter and no marker.

declared_release.description: What the .snt_release marker says was last deployed: intent, not verified fact. null when the marker is absent.

releases_considered.description: Every published release of the repository, in published_at order (oldest first).

incomplete.description: true when at least one release manifest, source or file could not be read. The report is then a partial account, not a pass.

by_status.description: Entry count per status. A status with no entries is omitted from this map.

inert_filesystem_copies.description: Repository-relative paths of files on the filesystem inside a pipeline directory. They never execute and are not classified.

scan_exclusions.description: What the filesystem walk skipped. The keys are frozen; the strings in directories_at_any_depth may include a prose rule and are x-display-only.

scope.description: Where the error arose: 'manifest:<tag>', 'pipeline_version:<code>' or 'pipeline_list'. New scope prefixes may be added.

blind_spots.description: What this report never looked at, so it cannot read as a clean bill of health.

status.description: Stable enum. match, mismatch_known, missing, removed_in_target and added_after_target occur only in verification mode; attributed only in attribution mode; the rest in both.

manifest_available.description: false when the release has no usable release_manifest.json. Such a release cannot be compared against and breaks attribution spans.

span.description: A run of consecutive releases (published_at order, over every release including those with no manifest) that all hold the same bytes. A single release is a span of one (from == to, count 1).

source.description: Where the bytes were read from. Each tracked path is read from exactly one source.

pipeline.description: Pipeline directory name for source pipeline_version; null for filesystem.

observed_sha256.description: Hash of the bytes found. null when the file is absent, or unreadable, or untracked on the filesystem (untracked files are never read).

target_sha256.description: Hash of the file in the target release. null in attribution mode, or when the target does not ship the path.

matching_releases.description: Spans over the releases whose manifest holds exactly the observed bytes at this path. Verification mode: the target is excluded, and the field is null on match entries. Attribution mode: every matching release. Two spans for one file means its content was changed and later reverted.

position.description: Where matching_releases sit relative to the target by published_at. older: behind. newer: ahead. both: changed in the target and later reverted. unordered: a matching release has no usable timestamp or the same one as the target. null when there are no matching releases, and always in attribution mode.

remediation.description: Text for a human. Wording depends on source as well as status. Never parse or compare it.

pipeline.description: Repository directory name; null for a deployed pipeline no release describes.

in_target.description: Whether the target release ships this pipeline. false on a deployed pipeline means it is not part of the target and is left in place. null in attribution mode.

current_version_name.description: The raw versionName from the API, e.g. 'v0.1.0-test [v1]' (OpenHEXA appends the version number). null when the pipeline is not deployed or could not be read.

current_version_claims_tag.description: The release tag parsed out of current_version_name.

version_name_matches_content.description: true when the zip holds exactly the files, byte for byte, that the named release ships for this pipeline. false otherwise, including an extra file or a name pointing at a release that does not ship the pipeline. null when the name is not a release tag with a usable manifest.

release_score.description: One release, judged only on the paths it ships (decision D15). Every count and ratio is null when manifest_available is false. A ratio is also null when its denominator is 0.

present.description: Of those, how many are found in the workspace.

agreeing.description: Of those present, how many have exactly the release's bytes.

extra.description: Files found in the workspace at paths the release does not ship. They count neither for nor against it.

attribution_summary.description: Present in both modes; the scores come from the observed bytes, not from each entry's status. A file unchanged across releases agrees with each of them, so no column adds up to 1.

files_scored.description: The denominator: every entry for a file present in the workspace, both sources together, except untracked and missing.

rule.description: A statement of how every number was computed.

by_release.description: One row per release in releases_considered, oldest first.

best_fit.description: Highest agreement, then highest completeness, then newest. null when no release agrees with any file.

matches_no_release.description: Files whose bytes match no release.

unreadable.description: Files that could not be read. Present but never agreeing.
